categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Carries the Wallet label and modifies core wallet database interfaces and callers across src/wallet/.
categories.rationale: Enforcing checks on database write operations prevents silent divergences between in-memory wallet state and persistent storage that can cause wallet corruption or data loss. As noted in the description, 'many database write failures are ignored, when they should probably be handled', risking persistent state desynchronization for key derivations and transaction updates.
